title: strong, sturdy, [relatively] easy to assemble
text:
strong, sturdy, [relatively] easy to assemble. howdy y'all,

first, if you want more shelves for this you _cannot_ get them in the "black anthracite" finish. shelves are only available in either black or silver.

this assembled pretty easily. i bought the casters for this kit and my _only_ complaint is that they used pressed-in leveler plugs. they SELL the posts with screw-in leveler plugs but do not use them for the starter kits.

for a clue on how to get the pressed-in plugs out, find a heavy item that will fit in the open end of the pole and drop it in. then do the shake-em-up-shuffle until the plug pops out. i used a 5/8" punch that a friend brought over.

a few bits of info ...
- if it aint obvious, the clips set on the inset rings so that the shelves do NOT align exactly at the inset rings.
- the space between wires on the 36x18 shelf is 5/8". so you likely won't need the plastic liner if your bits-n-pieces are bigger than that.
- if you aren't tall, you will pro'ly want to assemble the entire thing on its side. trying to reach up and align the poles with the holes in the shelf corners was a bit of work for me and i'm 6'1".
- they are pretty sturdy. i weigh 160 and stood on the bottom shelf to test it. no wobble at all.

to make things very clear - i'm buying another set of these and a pair of black shelves to split between the two sets.

rated a THREE since it does what i expected it to do and no more than that.

take care,
lee
